meta.title: Cloning an event whose live round had a line deleted should not fail
gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The setup does not create an event with three lines, a deleted second line, or a hidden invited vendor.
The clone cannot be read back because read_event requires eventGroupUuid and clone_event provides cloneUuid.
The expected untyped HTTP 500 cannot be asserted with the available assertion vocabulary.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.
